title: Seri muka kuih
hookLine: Malaysian-inspired seri muka kuih with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Seri muka kuih
steps.instructionTemplate: Soak glutinous rice with water for at least 1 ½ hours prior to using. Drain. Prepare a 9-inch round or square cake pan and spray with cooking spray or line with plastic wrap. Mix coconut milk, water, salt and the rice. Pour it into cake pan, topped with the pandan knots. Incorporate {m53054_1}, {m53054_2}, {m53054_3}, and {m53054_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure rice first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Seri muka kuih
steps.instructionTemplate: Steam for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, fluff up the rice and remove pandan knots. Then, using a greased spatula, flatten the steamed rice. Make sure there are no holes/air bubbles and gaps in the rice, especially the sides. Steam for another 10 minutes. Incorporate {m53054_5}, {m53054_6}, {m53054_7}, {m53054_8}, and {m53054_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Portion, Shape & Layer Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Combine pandan juice, coconut milk, all purpose flour, cornflour, and sugar. Mix well. Add eggs and whisk well then strain into a medium sized metal bowl or pot. Place pandan mixture over simmering water (double boiler or bain-marie).

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Seri muka kuih
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir continuously and cook till custard starts to thicken. (15 minutes) Pour pandan custard into glutinous rice layer, give it a little tap (for air bubbles) and continue to steam for 30 minutes. Remove kuih seri muka from the steamer and allow to cool completely before cutting into rectangles or diamond shapes.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
